summary:
**Market summary for 2026-11-16 (prior session: 2026-11-13)**

U.S. equities mostly declined. The S&P 500 (SPY) fell 0.36% and the Nasdaq 100 (QQQ) lost 1.20%, led by technology (XLK, -2.01%). The Dow (DIA) rose 0.13%. Consumer staples (XLP, +1.42%) and communication services (XLC, +1.05%) led sector gains. Long Treasuries (TLT) slipped 0.43%, gold (GLD) gained 0.16%, and VIX short-term futures (VIXY) rose 2.46%.

Economic data were mixed against consensus. Initial jobless claims were 200K versus 194K expected, existing home sales were 3.75M versus 3.89M, and the federal budget deficit was -404.0B versus -298.6B. The 30-year bond auction cleared at 5.441%.

Pre-market, QQQ was down 0.97% and XLK down 1.49%. Headlines centered on Nvidia, following reports on CEO Jensen Huang and China chip sales. Pre-market movers included DRTS (+12.9%) and SMMT (-22.1%), but these prints occurred on limited volume and may not reflect actual trading prices.
